name: WCP Solutions
old_description: Call today to speak with our customer service team, sign up for an account, and learn about our products, services, and equipment solutions.
about:
WCP Solutions traces its roots to March 1, 1930, when the company began operating out of a Ford Model A in Seattle’s Pike Place Market and International District. Now a third-generation, privately owned wholesale distributor, the business serves the Pacific Northwest and beyond from multiple divisions, including the Idaho Falls location managed by division manager Brad Bolander. The Idaho Falls division covers eastern Idaho, northern Utah, and western Wyoming from its warehouse at 130 South Colorado Avenue.

The company distributes paper and envelopes, packaging and shipping supplies, facility and janitorial products, food-service disposables, and personal protective equipment. It also sells, integrates, and services janitorial and packaging equipment. An in-house converting and manufacturing team produces Perfect Fit® custom sheets, prototypes, and envelopes, while local warehouses and a fleet of yellow delivery trucks support next-day service across the region.

Customers range from commercial printers and creative agencies to restaurants, food processors, healthcare facilities, universities, and grocery retailers. Long-term accounts include Idahoan Foods in Idaho Falls, Kent’s Meats & Groceries in Redding, A.T. Publishing & Printing in Anchorage, the University of Oregon in Eugene, Capitol City Press in Tumwater, and Rogue Valley Medical Center in Medford.

WCP emphasizes locally based support that spans consulting, sourcing, stocking, and delivery, backed by online ordering tools. The company’s WCP Cares program directs each division to partner with a local nonprofit; the Idaho Falls division supports the 1614 Revival Foundation, a refuge for survivors of domestic violence. Sustainability initiatives include recycling all paper waste by grade, reusing wood pallets and plastic packaging, and operating a fleet that meets CARB standards with electric material-handling equipment in warehouses.
